# Varint v1.6.0 - Table of Contents

> A library to compress integers using LEB128 and SLEB128.

## Pages

- [Varint](https://varint.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Varint.LEB128](https://varint.hexdocs.pm/Varint.LEB128.md): This module provides functions to convert unsigned integers to and from LEB128 encoded integers.
- [Varint.SLEB128](https://varint.hexdocs.pm/Varint.SLEB128.md): This module provides functions to convert signed integers to and from SLEB128 encoded integers.
- [Varint.Zigzag](https://varint.hexdocs.pm/Varint.Zigzag.md): This module provides functions to work with signed integers in conjunction with
LEB128 encoding.
